## load in libraries
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(wesanderson)
```

## load in data tables for summary statistics
```{r}
crypt_metadata<-read.csv('../Data/biopsy_metadata.csv')
crypt_signature_attributions<-read.csv('../Data/crypt_signature_attributions.csv')
```

# CONSTRUCT METADATA FOR ALL STUDY PARTICIPANTS
state summary of number of crypts / biopsies / donors 
```{r}
# Number of crypts / biopsies / patients
crypts_included <- nrow(crypt_metadata) 
biopsies_included <- length(unique(crypt_metadata$biopsy))
donors_included <- length(unique(crypt_metadata$patient))

print(paste0("Crypts included: ", crypts_included))     # n = 836 crypts
print(paste0("Biopsies included: ", biopsies_included)) # n = 131 biopsies
print(paste0("Patients included: ", donors_included))   # n = 85 individuals
```

state breakdown of children by cohort
```{r}
# Number of children per cohort
cohort_patients <- crypt_metadata %>%
  group_by(cohort) %>%
  summarise(patients = n_distinct(patient))

# Number of biopsies per cohort
cohort_biopsies <- crypt_metadata %>%
  group_by(cohort) %>%
  summarise(biopsies = n_distinct(biopsy))

print(merge(cohort_patients, cohort_biopsies))
```
state breakdown by nationality
```{r}
crypt_metadata %>%
  distinct(patient, nationality) %>%
  group_by(nationality) %>%
  summarise(patients = n()) # Danish=14 | UK = 71
```
state breakdown by IBD types
```{r}
# Patients by IBD subtype
ibd_patients <- crypt_metadata %>%
  filter(cohort == "IBD") %>%
  group_by(colonoscopy_results) %>%
  summarise(patients = n_distinct(patient))

# Biopsies by IBD subtype
ibd_biopsies <- crypt_metadata %>%
  filter(cohort == "IBD") %>%
  group_by(colonoscopy_results) %>%
  summarise(biopsies = n_distinct(biopsy))

merge(ibd_patients, ibd_biopsies)
```
state breakdown of treatment amongst IBD individuals 
```{r}
crypt_metadata %>%
  filter(cohort == "IBD", treatment != "Nil") %>%
  group_by(treatment) %>%
  summarise(patients = n_distinct(patient))
```
state breakdown of histologically normal indings
```{r}
# Patients
histologically_normal_patients <- crypt_metadata %>%
  filter(cohort != "IBD") %>%
  group_by(colonoscopy_finding) %>%
  summarise(patients = n_distinct(patient))

# Biopsies
histologically_normal_biopsies <- crypt_metadata %>%
  filter(cohort != "IBD") %>%
  group_by(colonoscopy_finding) %>%
  summarise(biopsies = n_distinct(biopsy))

# Merge summaries
histologically_normal_summary <- merge(histologically_normal_patients, histologically_normal_biopsies)
```
```{r}
#total patients and biopsies
print(paste0('Histologically normal donors: ', sum(histologically_normal_patients$patients)))
print(paste0('Histologically normal biopsies: ', sum(histologically_normal_biopsies$biopsies)))
```
print the breakdown by colonoscopy finding amongst histologically normal individuals
```{r}
print(histologically_normal_summary)
```

state number of biopsies by location :
```{r}
crypt_metadata %>%
  group_by(location) %>%
  summarise(biopsies = n_distinct(biopsy))
```

### v : age and gender of individuals :
```{r}
## age breakdown
crypt_metadata %>%
  distinct(patient, age) %>%
  summarise(
    median_age = round(median(age, na.rm = TRUE),digits=1),
    min_age = round(min(age, na.rm = TRUE),digits=1),
    max_age =round(max(age, na.rm = TRUE),digits=1)
  )
```

```{r}
## sex breakdown
crypt_metadata %>%
  distinct(patient, sex) %>%
  group_by(sex) %>%
  summarise(count = n()) %>%
  mutate(proportion = count / sum(count) * 100)
```

# COVERAGE AND SEQUENCING STATISTICS :
```{r}
# Median sequencing coverage / total snvs / indel muts
median_cov <- median(crypt_signature_attributions$coverage, na.rm = TRUE)
total_snvs <- sum(as.numeric(crypt_signature_attributions$snv_muts), na.rm = TRUE)
total_indels <- sum(as.numeric(crypt_signature_attributions$indel_muts), na.rm = TRUE)

print(paste0("Median coverage: ", median_cov))
print(paste0("Total SNVs: ", total_snvs))
print(paste0("Total indels: ", total_indels))
```

## PLOT HEATMAP FOR COHORT OVERVIEW
```{r}
# construct heatmap annotation dataframe :
patient_heatmap_metadata<-crypt_metadata%>%
  dplyr::select(patient, age,sex,nationality, colonoscopy_finding)%>%
  filter(!duplicated(patient))%>%
  mutate(sex=str_replace(sex,'FEMALE','Female'),
         sex=str_replace(sex,'MALE','Male'),
         
         # reformat the colonoscopy results :
         colonoscopy_finding=case_when(str_detect(colonoscopy_finding,'IBDUnclassified') ~ 'IBD Unclassified',
                                       colonoscopy_finding%in%c('CD','UC','FAP','Histologically_Normal','Lymphocytic gastritis','Juvenile Polyp') ~ colonoscopy_finding, 
                                       colonoscopy_finding%in%c('Threadworm','Infection') ~ 'Infection', # aggregate threadworm and infection for simplicity
                                       .default='Other'),
         
         # lengthen the following to their full name :
         colonoscopy_finding=str_replace(colonoscopy_finding,'UC','Ulcerative Colitis'),
         colonoscopy_finding=str_replace(colonoscopy_finding,'CD',"Crohn's Disease"),
         colonoscopy_finding=str_replace(colonoscopy_finding,'Histologically_Normal','Normal'),
         colonoscopy_finding=str_replace(colonoscopy_finding,'FAP', 'Familial Adenomatous Polyposis'), 
         colonoscopy_finding=str_replace(colonoscopy_finding,'IBD','Inflammatory Bowel Disease'))%>%
  column_to_rownames(var='patient')%>%
  arrange(age)%>%
  mutate(across(!starts_with('age'), ~factor(.x)))

## create an annotation dataframe
age_col_fun <- colorRamp2(
  range(patient_heatmap_metadata$age, na.rm = TRUE),
  c("ivory2", "red4")
)
ha <- HeatmapAnnotation(
  Age = patient_heatmap_metadata$age,
  Sex = patient_heatmap_metadata$sex,
  Nationality = patient_heatmap_metadata$nationality,
  `Colonoscopy Indication` = patient_heatmap_metadata$colonoscopy_indication,
  `Colonoscopy Results` = factor(patient_heatmap_metadata$colonoscopy_finding,
                                 levels=c('Normal','Infection','Juvenile Polyp','Lymphocytic gastritis','Familial Adenomatous Polyposis',"Crohn's Disease",'Inflammatory Bowel Disease Unclassified','Ulcerative Colitis','Other')),
  Treatment = patient_heatmap_metadata$treatment,
  col = list(
    Age=age_col_fun,
   # `Age Range`=c('0-4yrs'='#0E6BA8','5-9yrs'='#ebd9aa','10-14yrs'='gold1','15-19yrs'='gold4'),
    Sex = c('Male' = 'darkslateblue', 'Female' ="#f3b255ff" ,'NA' = "grey90"),
    Nationality=c('UK'= "orchid4",'Danish'='palevioletred'),
   `Colonoscopy Results` = c(
    'Normal'                               = 'darkolivegreen4',
    'Infection'                            = 'lightskyblue4',
    'Familial Adenomatous Polyposis'       = 'firebrick4',
       'Juvenile Polyp'                       = 'pink3',
    'Lymphocytic gastritis'                = 'lightsalmon', 
    'Inflammatory Bowel Disease Unclassified' = 'burlywood3',
    "Crohn's Disease"                      = 'tan4',
    'Ulcerative Colitis'                   = 'wheat2'
  )),
  annotation_name_side='left',  
  annotation_name_gp = grid::gpar(fontface = "bold")

)
n_patients <- nrow(patient_heatmap_metadata)

## plot the heatmap :
svg('childhood_colon_metadata.svg', width=12,height=4,bg='transparent')
draw(
  Heatmap(
    matrix(1, nrow = 0, ncol = n_patients),
    top_annotation = ha,
    show_heatmap_legend = FALSE,
  ),
  annotation_legend_side = "bottom",  # or "left", "bottom", "top"
)

dev.off()
```
